Spire Inc. (“Spire” or the “Company”), headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, is a regulated energy company primarily engaged in the distribution of natural gas. The Company’s regulated natural gas distribution operations include Spire Missouri, serving customers in Missouri; Spire Alabama, serving customers in central and northern Alabama; Spire Gulf and Spire Mississippi, subsidiaries of Spire EnergySouth, serving customers in southern Alabama and south-central Mississippi, respectively; and Spire Tennessee, serving customers in the Nashville metropolitan area and surrounding communities in Tennessee.
On March 31, 2026, Spire completed the acquisition of the Tennessee natural gas business of Piedmont Natural Gas Company, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Duke Energy Corporation (the “Piedmont Tennessee Transaction” or “Piedmont Tennessee”). The acquisition expanded Spire’s regulated natural gas utility operations into Tennessee. Upon closing, the acquired operations began doing business as Spire Tennessee. See Note 2 , Acquisitions, for additional information.
During fiscal 2026, as part of a strategic repositioning to focus on its core regulated natural gas utility business, the Company committed to the divestiture of certain businesses. On April 30, 2026, the Company completed the sale of Spire Marketing and on June 30, 2026, completed the sale of its natural gas storage operations, Spire Storage. In addition, on April 21, 2026, Spire EnergySouth entered into an agreement to sell Spire Mississippi. The sale is expected to close during the first quarter of fiscal 2027, subject to approval by the MSPSC and other customary closing conditions. As of September 30, 2026, Spire Mississippi remained classified as held for sale (see Note 3 , Divestitures, for additional information).
Historically, the Company managed its business through three reportable segments: Gas Utility, Gas Marketing and Midstream. Following the divestitures of Spire Marketing and Spire Storage, the Company revised its segment reporting and now has one reportable segment, Gas Utility. The Gas Utility segment includes the regulated operations of Spire Missouri, Spire Alabama, Spire Gulf, Spire Mississippi and Spire Tennessee. Other components of the Company’s consolidated operations include subsidiaries engaged in the operation of federally regulated natural gas pipelines, risk management and other activities, as well as unallocated corporate activities, including certain debt and associated interest costs.
The Company’s earnings from continuing operations are derived primarily from its Gas Utility segment. Due to the seasonal nature of the Company’s regulated utility operations and their volumetric rate design, earnings are typically concentrated during the heating season from November through April.
For a full discussion of the general development of our business, see Item 1 , Business, of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025, which is incorporated herein by reference.
